senses.gloss: (transpos. of כשכש) to knock about, shake; to dabble.
units: <cite ref="Menachot 23a:2">Men. 23ᵃ</cite> <he>הוא עצמו מְשַׁכְשְׁכוֹ בשירי הלוג</he> (Rashi seems to read: <he>משפשפו</he>) he himself wipes it (the meal offering) in the remainder of the Log of oil; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 474">Yalk. Lev. 474</cite>.
<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 33b:7">Ab. Zar. 33ᵇ</cite> <he>מְשַׁכְשְׁכָן במים וכ׳</he> he washes them (the vessels) in water, and they are permitted.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Terumot 3:2:6">Y. Ter. III, 42ᵃ</cite> bot. <he>ואחרים מְשַׁכְשְׁכִין בו</he> (not <he>בהן</he>) and other people dabble in it (put in vessels or their hands to lap of it); <cite ref="Tosefta Terumot 1:8">Tosef. ib. I, 8</cite> <he>משתמשין</he>.
